name: InterruptCard
label: Interrupt card
description: A human-in-the-loop checkpoint with a question from the agent and option buttons to decide.

props.name: title
props.description:
The question, e.g. "Allow file edit?".
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which InterruptCard does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: One line of context under the title.

props.name: icon
props.description: A Material Symbol name trailing the title, or any custom element. No icon by default.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, rendered as buttons left to right.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the chosen option's value.

props.name: value
props.description:
The already-chosen value. When set, the card renders its answered state:
the options give way to the chosen one's read-out, worded as the
decision made, in the status that choice records.

props.name: answeredLabel
props.description: Override the answered read-out's text (default: the chosen option's `answeredLabel`, then its label).

props.name: waitingLabel
props.description: Visually hidden status announced while the card waits for a decision. Defaults to "Waiting for your decision".

props.name: children
props.description:
Detail slot between the description and the options — typically a
`<ToolCall status="pending">` showing what wants to run.

props.name: bare
props.description: Strip the card chrome (fill, border, radius) when the card sits inside another panel that supplies the surface, such as AiButton's request panel.

InterruptCardAnsweredVariant.description: The status an answered card records: an approval, a refusal, or neither.

InterruptCardOption.description: One choice the card offers, rendered as a Button in the options footer.
